# Abbott India Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Search/document budget reached before FY2022-23 and FY2021-22 aggregate/project CSR figures could be located; the strongest primary sources (MCA/BSE-hosted annual report and BRSR PDFs) are registered HELD/not_checked and could not be read directly, so figures were taken from a CSR-data aggregator (thebhoomi.in, sourced from the MCA National CSR Portal) and a secondary news summary of the FY2024-25 annual report (indiacsr.in) rather than the primary filings themselves. No csr_year aggregate totals (prescribed_csr/total_spent) were found for FY2023-24, FY2022-23 or FY2021-22 specifically; no stated_geography, additional named partners, or grants to named recipients were found.

Confirmed entity: Abbott India Limited (CIN L24239MH1944PLC007330), the listed, Section 135-bound Indian subsidiary of global parent Abbott Laboratories (US) - the parent itself is not a distinct India CSR-135 filer. Reliable recent CSR data was found for FY2023-24 (5 MCA-disclosed projects, Health Care and Special Education, totalling roughly Rs 23.46 Cr across Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and locations tagged 'Pan India' including Delhi and Srinagar) and FY2024-25 (2 MCA-disclosed projects in Maharashtra totalling ~Rs 24.68 Cr per the MCA portal, vs Rs 25.75 crore total CSR spend / Rs 26.47 crore prescribed CSR per the company's own annual-report summary reported by India CSR Network - a source discrepancy between MCA project-level disclosure and the annual report's own headline figures worth resolving against the primary filing). Recurring theme: a STEM-education-and-healthy-living schools programme in Mumbai, Maharashtra, appearing in both FY2023-24 and FY2024-25. Sectors are consistently Health Care (majority) and Education/Special Education (minority). No named NGO/implementing-agency partners were disclosed except an unconfirmed 'Sewa' reference in one FY2023-24 project title. FY2022-23 and FY2021-22 figures were not reached within budget - the primary CSR annexure/BRSR PDF is hosted on bseindia.com, a HELD source, and no secondary source with those years' figures was found. No explicit 'stated priority geography' distinct from actual footprint was found. CSR Committee membership was captured from the company website, with one apparent conflict: the CSR Committee page lists Kartik Rajendran as Managing Director while the MCA-derived company registry (Zauba Corp) shows Swati Rohan Dalal appointed Managing Director effective 2024-04-05 - unresolved.

Website: https://www.abbott.co.in

## What it set out to find

- Confirm correct legal entity for Section 135 CSR obligation (Abbott India Limited vs global parent Abbott Laboratories)
- Identifiers: CIN, domain
- CSR years FY2023-24, FY2022-23, FY2021-22: section_135_applicable, prescribed_csr, spent_on_projects, total_spent, impact_assessment_done
- CSR spend by project/aggregate: sector, state, district, implementing agency, amount
- Footprint (actual states/districts funded) vs stated priority geography
- Partners (NGO/hospital/govt) by year, canonical name, kind
- Programs/themes
- Metrics (beneficiaries etc) with stage/method
- Public CSR contacts
- Source documents (annual report CSR annexure, BRSR, CSR committee disclosure)
